record.question: If the record is not received back within adequate time, ________ should be sent to the Doctors to returned the record.
record.explanation: Answer A: reminder. An overdue record request is followed up by sending a reminder to the physician. A tracer card stays in the file rack as a marker while a record is on loan. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/208125/9290610050_rev_eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
